lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-luminance circular clusters are arranged in a regular grid consisting of approximately five vertical columns on the visible mid-lateral flank posterior to the pectoral fin attachment point.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity align with the vertical columns of spots, creating a distinct rectilinear lattice pattern across the mid-section of the flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Two primary horizontal ridges are visible running along the upper third of the flank, characterized by a sharp vertical luminance gradient with high intensity on the superior edge and localized shadow on the inferior edge.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: The visible portion of the first dorsal fin exhibits high-luminance spots distributed in vertical rows, with at least five individual spots discernible on its surface.

other_distinctive_markers: Multiple small, elongated, low-luminance silhouettes representing commensal fish are clustered in the water column ventral to the primary pectoral fin.
